fieldManual.fmPanel.nuffleDemandsTheatre: Nuffle demands theatre. Fan factor, weather, the coin toss and inducements each get their beat before the boot hits the ball — and the big moments land as centre-pitch banners (yes, the Halfling Master Chef announces his thefts in gold).
fieldManual.fmPanel.theActionMenuShows: The action menu shows only what's legal right now — nothing is greyed out, it's present or absent.
fieldManual.fmPanel.theGoldHaloMarks: the gold halo marks the player being activated; the ring under each player is white until they act, then grey. Skill icons ride over heads (or as text markers at the feet) — tune them in Settings → Display → Skill display config.
fieldManual.rails.beforeMovingLeftClick: Before moving, left-click an adjacent standing enemy: the dice preview appears with Confirm Block on the bar. Click the same enemy again to throw it. Right-click the target for Stab, Chainsaw and the other flavours.
fieldManual.settingsStops.textSizeFontCo: Minimum text size, UI font, colourblind remap and pitch brightness.
hud.replayTelestrator.pathCtrl1Click: Path (Ctrl+1) — click a square and drag; the arrow follows square centres
login.registerModal.richUseFumbblName: Please use your actual FUMBBL name — it's how opponents will recognise and challenge you on the fork.
settings.assetPacks.assetPackCreator.one: One pitch can cover any combination of weather states. It is normalised to the renderer's 782×452 pitch canvas.

settings.credits.colouringOfPortraitsBy: — Colouring of portraits by Knut Rockie.
settings.credits.contentLicensedUnderThi: Content licensed under this licence is marked with an icon on the source page (icon markers are not reproduced in this mirror).
settings.credits.drawingAndColouringA: — Drawing and colouring a number of star player portraits.
settings.credits.fumbblIsGrantedA: FUMBBL is granted a licence to use, modify, and distribute the contributed media assets for any purpose, including commercial purposes.
settings.credits.licensingOfMediaAssets: Licensing of media assets has historically been a little bit complicated. settings.credits.thirdPartiesAreGranted: Third parties are granted a licence to use, modify, and distribute the contributed media assets for non-commercial purposes but may not use them for direct commercial purposes. This includes selling the assets or using them on merchandise or products that are sold.
settings.display.log.graphicalEachLineIs: Graphical: each line is a row in the acting team's colour, with the action's icon (and a reroll's source) on the left.
setupWizard.setupSteps.chooseTheColourOf: Choose the colour of the rolling dice.
setupWizard.setupSteps.playTravelsFromEa: Play travels from East to West. You'll always play on the left side of the pitch and offence will always drive to the right in spectator mode.
store.text.blitzCancelledThisTeam: ⚠ Blitz cancelled — this team has already used its Blitz this turn.
store.text.foulCancelledTheFouler: ⚠ Foul cancelled — the fouler can’t reach the victim (no walk path). Move adjacent first.
store.text.moveCancelledP0Already: ⚠ Move cancelled — {p0} already selected a target; finish or end that action first.
settings.info.backdropColor: The backdrop colour when Backdrop is set to a colour.
settings.info.chatStyle: Chat as bubbles in the speaker's team colour, or as plain lines.
settings.info.colorPreset: Preset accent colours. Text colour is picked automatically, so it stays readable.
settings.info.colorblind: Adjusts team and status colours for colour blindness.
settings.info.gridLines: Draws the square grid on the pitch. Turn it off or recolour it if a busy turf is hard to read.
settings.info.logStyle: Text: plain lines. Graphical: rows in the acting team's colour, with action icons. FUMBBL: the FUMBBL client's wording and layout.
settings.info.logTint: How strongly the team colours paint the Graphical rows.
settings.info.markColor: Colour of Shift-click marks and telestrator drawings.
settings.info.plannerPrimary: Colour of the planned route line.
settings.info.plannerSecondary: Colour of the steps on a planned route that need a roll: a dodge, a rush or a pickup.
settings.info.positionRings: A coloured ring under each player, by position.
settings.info.primaryAccent: Accent colour for a Custom theme.
settings.info.ringColor: Ring colour: one per position, or one colour for all.
settings.info.secondaryBase: Base colour for a Custom theme.
settings.info.trailColor: Colour of the trail left behind a moving player.
settings.info.uiColorScheme: Dark or light colours for the interface.
settings.mods.dice.routeAndReachRoll: Route and reach roll chips wear the mover's home or away die. Off: the neutral grey die.
teamBuilder.text.yourCoachSessionIs: Your coach session is no longer authorised. Reconnect in Settings, then retry this advancement.
tour.settingsLines.accessibility: Accessibility sets the text size and font, colourblind mode and pitch brightness.
tour.settingsLines.credits: Credits shows the client version, the attributions and licences, and the FUMBBL contributors behind it all.
onboarding.details.preferredNameHelp: What organisers and other coaches call you.
